mapper.select: SELECT id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(operation_detail, '$.fromStatus')) from_status, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(operation_detail, '$.toStatus')) to_status, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(operation_detail, '$.lifecycleVersion')) AS UNSIGNED) version, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(operation_detail, '$.reason')) reason, JSON_EXTRACT(operation_detail, '$.evidence') evidence, user_id changed_by, event_time changed_at FROM t_system_audit_log WHERE operation = #{operation} AND target_type = #{type} AND target_id = CAST(#{id} AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_as_cs ORDER BY version
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_system_audit_log(user_id, operation, audit_class, outcome, target_type, target_id, operation_detail, detail_schema_version, event_time, idempotency_key) VALUES(#{actor}, #{operation}, 'BUSINESS', 'SUCCESS', #{type}, #{target}, JSON_OBJECT('fromStatus', #{from}, 'toStatus', #{to}, 'lifecycleVersion', #{version}, 'reason', #{reason}, 'evidence', CAST(#{evidenceJson} AS JSON)), 'alert-lifecycle-v1', NOW(3), CONCAT(#{type}, ':', #{id}, ':', #{version}))
